name: Cargo seal specialist
design: Broad muscular male with reddish copper hide, wide heavy mandibled face, scar through one outer brow, short thick dreadlocks swept back. Black leather vest with reinforced shoulders and a long diagonal grey linen sash, broad bronze belt, cropped dark wrap trousers. Holds an irregular hexagonal stamp tool safely downward in left hand and a bundle of small unmarked metal seal plates in right. Strong relaxed stance.
